# Strand Orientation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:StrandOrientation`](gmeow-StrandOrientation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StrandOrientation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The strand direction of a feature on a double-stranded biological sequence (forward / Watson, reverse / Crick, or both). A value, not a subclass: the set is closed and they share the same structure.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:StrandOrientation`](gmeow-StrandOrientation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reference the strand direction of a sequence feature (forward/Watson, reverse/Crick, or both) as a value individual.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing for strand direction (the set is closed and shares structure).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:StrandOrientation`](gmeow-StrandOrientation.md) individual from [`SequenceCoordinates`](gmeow-SequenceCoordinates.md) via [`gmeow:sequenceStrand`](../properties/gmeow-sequenceStrand.md).
